messages:
Ava: Uploaded a trimmed launch-blog draft to Drive: https://drive.redwood.co/launch-short. Quick reads needed on benchmark phrasing and CTA routing. Goal: lock tonight for Wed 9am PT publish.

Priya: On benchmarks. Suggest: move the numeric claim to the subhead and hedge with 'up to'. Add a one-line methodology link.

Ava: Will do: subhead = 'Up to 2.5x lower token cost in our internal benchmarks'; footnote links to methodology doc.

Jon: Legal nod — use 'up to' and add "results may vary by workload". @LegalBot please confirm.

LegalBot: Confirmed. Hedged phrasing acceptable; include methodology link and disclaimer.

Marco: CTA routing for HubSpot: split flows for live attendees, no-shows, and general blog leads. Small snippet: 
```
if (attended) flow='attendees_followup';
else if (registered) flow='replay_nurture';
else flow='general_inbound';
```
Also set utm_campaign dynamically.

Ava: Adding snippet and UTM defaults (utm_source=blog, utm_medium=post). Lina: UI copy?

Lina: Primary = "Register for webinar"; Secondary = "Read technical notes". On mobile stack buttons and keep CTA above the fold.

Ava: Updated CMS. Publish checklist for @PublishBot: final copy in CMS, hero image on CDN, HubSpot webhook configured, social scheduled. Can you smoke-test webhook at publish?

PublishBot: Scheduled smoke test 2026-06-03T16:00:00Z. Will confirm here once webhook passes. :robot_face:

Ava: Final tweak: headline softened to avoid overclaim. Pinging Jon for last read in 15.

Jon: Quick pass done. Change 'production-grade' -> 'production-ready' in body. All good otherwise.

PublishBot: Smoke webhook OK at 2026-06-03T16:02:12Z  routed to `attendees_followup`.
